name: Sunrise Electronics, Inc.
old_description: Since 1997 we've built lasting relationships by getting it right the first time, every time.
about:
Sunrise Electronics, Inc. operates from Elk Grove Village, Illinois, where it was founded in 1997 as a family-owned business. The company began with a focus on building lasting customer relationships through reliable printed circuit board manufacturing.

The company fabricates a full spectrum of PCBs under one roof, from single-sided prototypes to 50-layer multilayer, HDI, rigid-flex, and flex circuits. Its facility handles panel sizes up to 24 by 30 inches, supports copper weights from 0.5 to 10 ounces, and offers surface finishes including ENIG, HASL, immersion silver, and hard gold. Production spans quick-turn prototypes — with same-day and 12-hour options — through high-volume runs managed with strategic supply-chain oversight.

Aerospace and defense programs represent core markets, supported by ITAR-aware processes and full traceability. The shop also serves medical and military applications, manufacturing to IPC-A-600 Class 2 and Class 3 standards.

Sunrise emphasizes in-house control from bare laminate to finished board, citing industry-leading internal yields and low defect rates. The operation holds ±5% impedance as standard (±3% on request), achieves 3 mil trace and space, and maintains a 15:1 drill aspect ratio, positioning itself on speed and precision without outsourcing.
